input.free_text_description: This system is a content management platform that serves User, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for custom user details password, custom user details, abstract bcc. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include authentication functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As an Operator, I want to view real-time device data and monitor system health, so that I can detect and respond to anomalies quickly.
As a User, I want to interact with account functionality, so that I can accomplish my account-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with alias functionality, so that I can accomplish my alias-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with bcc functionality, so that I can accomplish my bcc-related tasks.
